name: Red Arrow
source:
A skier recovering from a season-ending injury is visited by her technician to discuss his future.

[From [url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/redarrow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名滑雪選手正從迫使她提前結束賽季的傷病中康復。她的器材技師來探望她，商量他自己接下來的打算。
